high-contrast.rejected: die d"erdelijn is wit op wit en onleesaar ook het stuk "info" en "warning" op de eerste drie lijnen zijn onleesbaar
high-contrast.change: The level word and the warning message took --info-foreground and --warning-foreground, which are the ink ON those plates and white in this theme: measured 1.00 to 1 on the card. A warning, an error and a critical now carry the plate itself with its own ink, which the contrast gate holds at 4.5 to 1; a routine line keeps the quiet word [fix-70].

nostromo.change: The warning message took --warning-foreground, hsl(38, 30%, 90%), on a card of hsl(38, 30%, 83%): 1.17 to 1. The warning now carries its plate with its own ink and the message is card ink; the stamp also stops at the second [fix-70].

shade-light.rejected: zelfde als het andere afgekeurde item, lijn drie is onleesbaar en de eerste drie lijnen van kolom 3. En sidenote: uur:minuten:seconden is goed, maar na seconden moet er niks komen, geen duizendsten. Dat is onwenselijk en vertroebeld het beeld. Dus doe dat stuk er overal af.
shade-light.change: The level word measured 1.01 to 1 and the warning message 1.04 to 1 on the log ground; both took a plate ink. The loud severities now carry their own plate, and every stamp in the package and in kp-tui stops at the second [fix-70].
